instruction: I would like to configure Chrome to allocate 2GB of VRAM for GPU acceleration instead of the default automatic allocation. This would ensure consistent graphics performance for WebGL applications without depending on Chrome's dynamic memory management.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide any setting to manually configure GPU memory allocation. Chrome's GPU acceleration memory usage is managed automatically by the browser based on system resources and graphics driver capabilities. This cannot be overridden through Chrome settings or flags.
